amendment_rule: Never edit this file. A change is a NEW file (p6-2.json) stating the reason, the changed analysis, and whether it is exploratory or confirmatory. p4a-1.json is unaffected by this record.

parent_protocol.relationship: ADDITIVE. p4a-1 is not replaced, re-parameterised or reinterpreted by this record.

analysis_classes.A. comprehensive metrics on p4a-1 held-o: secondary and descriptive; no model is refitted
analysis_classes.B. extension candidate families (p6-1-ex: EXPLORATORY; hypotheses are written down, results are hypotheses for an independent cohort
analysis_classes.D. decision curves: diagnostic only until a clinical action and threshold range are defined by clinicians
analysis_classes.E. subgroups: descriptive; reported only above fixed minimum sizes

protocol.threshold_note: same fixed a-priori value as p4a-1; no operating point is chosen from evaluation data; clinically justified thresholds REQUIRE_CLINICAL_INPUT
protocol.uncertainty: cluster (subject) bootstrap, percentile, 95%; paired resamples for model comparisons
protocol.pairing_rule: extension and p4a-1 predictions may be compared only when every (seed, row) has the same outer fold in both runs

voice_value_study.decision_rule: unchanged from p4a-1 (interval of FULL minus each reference excludes 0 for every reference and every seed)
voice_value_study.inconclusive_rule: if the rule is not met the result is reported INCONCLUSIVE with the additional data estimated by ml.validation.power_planning, not as 'voice has no value'

decision_curve.interpretation: REQUIRES_CLINICAL_INPUT: no clinical action or threshold range is defined

risk: age_tertile (cut points from subject ages only)
baseline_severity_tertile (cut points from first-visit scores only)

recalibration.method: logistic on logit(score), grouped 5-fold across subjects, fitted on other subjects' held-out scores
recalibration.label: EXPLORATORY_NOT_A_DEPLOYABLE_CALIBRATION

protocol.acceptance_criteria: REQUIRES_CLINICAL_INPUT: no performance target is set by this record
not_estimable_from_public_data: missing-voice behaviour (the public files have no missing voice records)
performance on a new site, device or population
